message.forecast-how-1.value: users gets a chance of buying. It starts from the conversion rate of past trial users who behaved like them in their first 3 trial days (active days and whether they activated; see “What predicts conversion”), pulled toward the overall
so small groups don’t swing to extremes.

message.forecast-how-2.value: That chance is spread over time by when people usually buy: a few during the trial, most in the days right after it ends, and a tail up to
days later. Someone 10 days past their trial end has used up most of their buying window, so their chance for the next 7 days is small.

message.forecast-how-3.value: The headline adds up everyone’s chances: 20 users at 10% each make 2 expected customers.
in the next 7 days is that sum; it can be a fraction because it is an average.

message.forecast-how-4.value: possible outcomes (each user buys or not, with their chance) and taking the middle 80%.

message.forecast-p-tip.value: Chance this user buys in the next 14 days. Tap or hover a value for the 7-day chance, the chance of buying at all, and the user’s behavior group.

message.forecast-range-tip.value: simulated outcomes. Few users with low chances make this range wide.

message.forecast-risk-tip.value: Trial ended, not bought: access stopped and they haven’t paid yet. Low engagement: at most 1 active day in the first 3 trial days. Not activated: never reached activation_complete.
